claims.nodeLabel: AARO Historical Record Report, Volume II (unpublished)
claims.text: A DoD spokeswoman told the Wall Street Journal in June 2025 that the Yankee Blue findings would be included in Volume II, then scheduled for late 2025.
The Office of the Secretary of Defense issued a memorandum in spring 2023 ordering the practice halted immediately.

Air Force personnel in classified units were briefed into a fictitious programme called Yankee Blue involving reverse-engineering of alien spacecraft, shown flying-saucer photographs, bound by NDAs, and in some accounts threatened with severe penalties for disclosure.
Officials briefed DNI Avril Haines that 'hundreds and hundreds' of personnel had been affected over decades.

title: Joel Schectman and Aruna Viswanatha, 'The Pentagon Disinformation That Fueled America's UFO Mythology', The Wall Street Journal, 6 June 2025. The canonical address is unreachable from this environment; the text was read in the To Vima republication at this URL.
